changes.what: A finding from the language model is dropped when its quote matches this turn only by the whole-sentence fallback AND the same (normalised) quote appears in one of the earlier turns the model was shown as context.
changes.why: Three needs-review flags (c07 turn 11, c12 turn 9, c13 turn 9) quoted a line from an earlier turn, so the flagged turn itself contained no violation.
changes.scope: engine.llm_to_findings and deep_findings only; no prompt, threshold, label or phrase-list change. Re-scored from the saved model answers (0 tokens).
